bidirectional_invariants: Every requirement test_ids entry resolves to exactly one tests.test_id.
Every tests.requirement_ids entry resolves to exactly one RFP or system requirement.
Every requirement-test edge is listed on both sides.
Every requirement has at least one design_id, test_id, evidence_id and gate_id.
Every test has exactly one procedure_id and evidence_id; duplicate IDs and unexpanded range tokens are forbidden.
Every requirement row has owner_ids, data_entity_ids and code_targets; every test row has direct owner_ids and executable procedure field references.

procedure_reference_contract.resolution_rule: For a test row, precondition_ids MUST equal its procedure_id plus -PRE; action_ids MUST enumerate the referenced procedure_catalog.actions in one-based order as -ACT-01..N with no gap; expected_result_id MUST equal procedure_id plus -EXPECTED. The resolved text is procedure_catalog.preconditions, actions, and expected respectively.
procedure_reference_contract.orphan_rule: A test field reference that cannot be derived exactly by this contract, or a catalog step without the corresponding derived action ID, is an orphan and fails GATE-DESIGN-INTEGRITY.

api_operation_resolution_contract.screen_resolution_rule: A requirement api_operation_ids entry MUST resolve to one exact screen api_operations entry or one exact service_only_operations entry. Every screen operation inherits its screen requirement_ids capability/intent and e2e_test_ids evidence path; those links MUST resolve bidirectionally and include at least one requirement-test intersection.
api_operation_resolution_contract.row_closure_rule: Each operation_id occurs exactly once in the enclosing screen operation_contracts row and inherits exact requirement_ids, test_ids, and evidence_ids; every test shares at least one requirement.
